systems.name: AgentFactory
systems.summary: Makes the HumanBot walker of a world: loads its body and params files, builds the Jolt ragdoll, configures the world's AgentIO and starts the first episode.

access.name: AgentIO
access.effect: Created in preinit, configured (behaviour, 276 observations, 120 actions, stacking sensor name), cleared and given DeVita's stats at the reset.

access.name: HumanBotSpawn
access.effect: The body and params files and the modes of the walker, from the first entity that has one.

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: Emplaced with the walker's whole state; its bodies and constraints removed at finish.

access.name: GroundField
access.effect: The world's std::shared_ptr<GroundField>, kept in HumanBot::ground.

access.name: WalkRoutes
access.effect: Copied from the spawn entity into HumanBot::routes.

access.name: TerrainColliders
access.effect: A mesh ground: LinearCast segments and TerrainUsers.

access.name: TerrainUsers
access.effect: The segment bodies, for WorldTerrain to build colliders around.

access.name: PhysicsWorld
access.effect: Bodies and swing-twist constraints created, placed, removed.

access.name: AgentEnvParams
access.effect: The trainer's environment parameters over the params file.

access.name: WorldRng
access.effect: Draws the target speed, the spawn point, the target, the yaw, the initial tumble and the slope sign.

access.name: Ground
access.effect: The flat ground boxes whose static Jolt bodies are tilted for the episode.

access.name: Parked
access.effect: Unparks the world at the episode start.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: On the drawn shape entities.

access.name: WorldShape
access.effect: One entity per shape of every segment, for WorldView.

access.name: ModelRef
access.effect: No model, a colour per segment for the drawn shape.

side_effects: Reads resources/<body> and resources/<params> and hashes them (SHA-256); throws AssetError on a malformed file.
Creates 16 Jolt bodies and, for a dynamic walker, 15 swing-twist constraints with motors; removes them at finish.
Moves the static Ground bodies at every episode start (slope) and sets the segments' poses, velocities and mass properties.
Creates the drawn shape entities when draw is set; they live as long as the world.
Logs errors without a HumanBotSpawn entity or with WalkRoutes but no ground field, a warning when no spawn point is found in the slope band.

systems.name: DriveTargets
systems.summary: Act phase of the walker: the window's action as the gains, torque limits, target orientations and target angular velocities of the joint motors.

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: Params, body and constraints read; target_clamps, decisions and window_ticks written.

access.name: AgentIO
access.effect: The action of the window (8 floats per joint).

side_effects: Changes the motor settings and targets of the walker's 15 Jolt SwingTwistConstraints.

systems.name: Disturbances
systems.summary: Random pushes on the walker while randomising with pushing on: an impulse and an angular impulse on one segment, push_chance per tick.

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: Params and bodies.

access.name: WorldRng
access.effect: The chance, the segment, the force and the torque.

access.name: PhysicsWorld
access.effect: AddImpulse and AddAngularImpulse on the segment's body.

side_effects: Impulses on a Jolt body of the walker.

systems.name: BodySync
systems.summary: After the physics step: the segments' world state, the joint anchors' finite-difference velocities, the tick counters and the drawn shapes' poses.

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: state, tick and window_ticks written.

access.name: PhysicsWorld
access.effect: Positions, rotations and velocities of the segment bodies.

access.name: WorldShape
access.effect: Segment and local pose of each drawn shape.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: The drawn shape's world pose.

access.name: PhysicsPose
access.effect: Previous and current pose for the viewer's interpolation, added on first use.

side_effects: Adds PhysicsPose to the drawn shape entities.

systems.name: Task
systems.summary: Unity's ArcUpdate: every arcFrames a new target (a direction in the slope band on a terrain) and, out of the continuous speed mode, a new target speed.

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: arc_ticks, target, target_speed, route_lost and the eval legs.

access.name: WorldClock
access.effect: dt to convert 60 Hz frames to the world's rate.

access.name: WorldRng
access.effect: Target, direction and speed draws.

systems.name: Termination
systems.summary: Ends a walker episode: killed after a fall (head too low), truncated at the time limit, the end of a recording or with no route left; a kill parks the world.

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: dying, dying_ticks, killed, truncated and the eval legs.

access.name: WorldClock
access.effect: The time limit at the world's rate.

access.name: Parked
access.effect: Parks the world until the end of the decision window.

side_effects: Parking skips PhysicsStep and the other non-observe systems of the world until the observe phase.

systems.name: Rewards
systems.summary: Observe phase: carries out a pending or requested reset, else the window's reward (root speed, life, win, death, energy) and the training stats.

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: State and snapshot read; maxima, dying, smoothed energy speed, window sums of the books, cumulative_reward written; the whole episode state at a reset.

access.name: AgentIO
access.effect: reset_requested cleared, action read, stats and reward written.

access.name: WorldClock
access.effect: dt for the length of the window.

access.name: AgentEnvParams
access.effect: The trainer's environment parameters over the params file, and the slope keys.

access.name: WorldRng
access.effect: Draws the target speed, the spawn point, the target, the yaw, the initial tumble and the slope sign.

access.name: PhysicsWorld
access.effect: Places the segment bodies, changes their mass properties and resets the constraints' warm start.

access.name: Ground
access.effect: The flat ground boxes whose static Jolt bodies are tilted for the episode.

access.name: Parked
access.effect: Unparks the world at every episode start.

side_effects: At a reset: the walker's and the Ground boxes' Jolt bodies are moved and mass properties changed; logs a warning when no spawn point is found in the slope band.

systems.name: Observation
systems.summary: Observe phase: the decision snapshot (command of the coming window) and the observation, two stacked heidelbot_notoes_2 frames of 138 floats.

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: State read; snapshot and previous_frame written.

access.name: AgentIO
access.effect: observation (276 floats).

systems.name: Episode
systems.summary: Observe phase: done and truncated for the host; at the end of an episode a pending reset and the world parked.

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: fresh cleared, killed and truncated read, pending_reset set.

access.name: AgentIO
access.effect: done and truncated.

access.name: Parked
access.effect: Parks the world at the end of an episode.

side_effects: Parking skips PhysicsStep and the every-tick systems of the world for one decision window.

systems.name: TrackActions
systems.summary: Plays baked pose tracks on the kinematic walker: MoveKinematic toward each frame in turn (the track demo recorder).

access.name: PoseTrackPlayer
access.effect: Loads the track, advances the frame.

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: Body name to check the track against, segment bodies.

access.name: WorldClock
access.effect: The world's dt against the track's.

access.name: PhysicsWorld
access.effect: SetPositionAndRotation at frame 0 and on teleports, MoveKinematic otherwise.

side_effects: Reads resources/<track>.track.json and its .track.bin; throws AssetError for another body or another dt.
Moves the kinematic Jolt bodies of the walker.

systems.name: Energy
systems.summary: Energy books of the step: whole-body energy, each joint motor's exact work from Jolt's motor impulses, contact impulses from the momentum balance, residual.

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: State, params, body and constraints read; books written.

access.name: PhysicsWorld
access.effect: Gravity of the world's config.

systems.name: DeVitaStepStat
systems.summary: DeVita's protocol: sagittal work of hip, knee and ankle over each stance of a foot, split by sign, and the step count (energy reward on or eval).

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: books, state and target read; devita written.

systems.name: EnergyFormulas
systems.summary: Eval only: the Lagrangian, recursive Newton-Euler and motor work formulas of a long rollout with their checks against Jolt, into FormulaBooks totals.

access.name: HumanBot
access.effect: State, constraints and books.tick_torque_variation read; formulas written.

access.name: ContactRecorderHandle
access.effect: The contact impulse listener, created on first use; its reports read and cleared every tick.

access.name: PhysicsWorld
access.effect: SetContactImpulseListener once; gravity.

side_effects: Installs a contact impulse listener on the world's Jolt PhysicsSystem (never removed).

components.name: AgentIO
components.summary: An agent as the training host sees it: behaviour, actions in, observations, sensors, reward, done and stats out.

fields.name: behavior
fields.desc: Behaviour name (one brain per behaviour).

fields.name: observation_size
fields.desc: Floats of the vector observation.

fields.name: action_size
fields.desc: Continuous actions.

fields.name: sensor_name
fields.desc: Name of the vector sensor sent to the trainer (VectorSensor_size<n>, or the walker's stacking sensor).

fields.name: branches
fields.desc: Sizes of the discrete action branches.

fields.name: action
fields.desc: Host to world: the decision of the coming window (zeros when none).

fields.name: discrete
fields.desc: Host to world: one choice per branch.

fields.name: reset_requested
fields.desc: Host to world: start a new episode at the next Observe phase (RESET).

fields.name: observation
fields.desc: World to host, written at the Observe phase.

fields.name: sensors
fields.desc: Further observations (vectors, or buffers of rows with a count), sent after the vector one.

fields.name: reward
fields.desc: Reward of the window that ended (since the last decision for a component).

fields.name: done
fields.desc: The episode ended with this observation.

fields.name: truncated
fields.desc: ... by a limit (time, bounds), not a terminal state.

fields.name: recordable
fields.desc: false: the observation belongs to no episode (a demo's warm-up), recorders skip it.

fields.name: stats
fields.desc: This window's stats (key, value, aggregation 0 average / 1 recent / 2 sum / 3 histogram), averaged over agents by the host.

fields.name: requested
fields.desc: Components only: the agent asks for a decision with this observation; cleared by the host when it sends it.

fields.name: id
fields.desc: Given by the host, unique in the run; kept by an entity over its episodes.

components.notes: Two uses: the one agent of a world as a world context variable (agentIO(reg) creates it; HumanBot, sphere roller, animal walkers), or a component on every agent entity (sandbox, pursuit), next to the AgentsReset context flag. configure(), addBranch(), addVector(), addBuffer() set it up. Read and written by the training host (src/train/worlds_env.cpp, train_host.cpp) and the policies of src/onnx/ between decision windows.

components.name: AgentsReset
components.summary: World context flag of worlds whose agents are components: the host's RESET for every agent at the next Observe phase.

fields.name: requested
fields.desc: Set by the host, cleared by the agents' systems when they start every agent again.

components.notes: Created by the agents' systems in preinit (sandbox, pursuit): its presence tells the host the world has agents before any entity exists.

components.name: AgentEnvParams
components.summary: The trainer's resolved environment parameters, read by a world's agents at each episode start.

fields.name: values
fields.desc: Parameter name to value; has() and get(name, fallback) read it.

components.notes: Written by the training host between decision windows (src/train/train_host.cpp); absent outside training, where agents keep their params file. Read by the walker's reset (applyEnvParams, applySlope), the animals and the sandbox.

components.name: HumanBot
components.summary: The HumanBot walker of a world: its files, Jolt bodies and constraints, segment state, command, episode counters and energy books.

fields.name: body
fields.desc: The body file (segments, joints, shapes), immutable.

fields.name: base_params
fields.desc: The params file as loaded.

fields.name: params
fields.desc: base_params with the env params on top, refreshed each episode.

fields.name: kinematic, recording, draw, view, view_truncate
fields.desc: Modes copied from HumanBotSpawn.

fields.name: view_speed
fields.desc: Command speed in view mode (1.36 m/s).

fields.name: recording_ticks
fields.desc: Episode length while recording (1000).

fields.name: built
fields.desc: The ragdoll exists.

fields.name: bodies
fields.desc: One Jolt body per segment.

fields.name: constraints
fields.desc: One per joint, empty when kinematic.

fields.name: frame1, frame2
fields.desc: Constraint space (X twist, Y plane, Z normal) to parent and child body rotation.

fields.name: built_mass
fields.desc: Total mass the bodies were last given.

fields.name: state
fields.desc: World position, rotation, linear and angular velocity of the 16 segments, previous anchors and anchor velocities of the 15 joints.

fields.name: est0
fields.desc: Head over the lower foot at the spawn pose (height reference).

fields.name: target
fields.desc: Where the walker is sent.

fields.name: target_speed
fields.desc: Commanded speed, m/s.

fields.name: continuous_speed_mode
fields.desc: Speed drawn once per episode from [targetSpeedMin, targetSpeedMax].

fields.name: snapshot
fields.desc: Spine, target velocity and speed the last observation carried: what the window is rewarded against.

fields.name: previous_frame
fields.desc: The older half of the observation stack.

fields.name: tick, decisions, window_ticks, arc_ticks, dying_ticks
fields.desc: Ticks of the episode, decisions, ticks of the window, ticks since the last target, ticks spent dying.

fields.name: dying, killed, truncated, pending_reset, fresh
fields.desc: Episode flags; fresh: first window of an episode.

fields.name: cumulative_reward
fields.desc: Reward of the episode so far.

fields.name: target_clamps
fields.desc: Target orientations Jolt clamped to the cone.

fields.name: books
fields.desc: Per-tick and per-window energy books (Energy): joint works and torques, contact impulses, energy, residuals, torque variation.

fields.name: devita
fields.desc: DeVita's stance windows of the two feet, step count (strikes), episode sums and run totals.

fields.name: formulas
fields.desc: Previous state, stance windows and FormulaTotals of EnergyFormulas.

fields.name: left_hip, left_knee, left_ankle, right_hip, right_knee, right_ankle
fields.desc: Joint indices of the legs.

fields.name: head_max_speed, head_max_error, head_max_height, head_min_height, root_max_speed, root_max_error, root_max_distance
fields.desc: Unity's normaliser maxima and extremes, for the same stat names.

fields.name: slope_angle
fields.desc: Default slope of the ground, degrees (0).

fields.name: slope_applied
fields.desc: This episode's slope, degrees.

fields.name: energy_speed, energy_speed_valid
fields.desc: Smoothed speed toward the target of the energy reward.

fields.name: ground
fields.desc: The world's ground field when it has one: heights are measured from it.

fields.name: routes
fields.desc: Set: episodes spawn and head where the ground stays in the slope band.

fields.name: origin
fields.desc: This episode's spawn point on the ground.

fields.name: spawn_spine
fields.desc: The spine at the start of the episode.

fields.name: route_lost
fields.desc: No direction in the band from where the walker stands: the episode is truncated.

fields.name: spawn_tries
fields.desc: Points drawn for this episode's spawn.

fields.name: legs, leg_open
fields.desc: Eval only: the stretches walked toward each target (from, to, direction, ticks, strikes, fell).

components.notes: Created by AgentFactory (init) from the HumanBotSpawn entity; its bodies are removed at AgentFactory's finish. resetHumanBot() starts every episode (AgentFactory init, Rewards). Methods groundUnder(p), currentHeight(), isDying(). Read outside the systems by the eval host (src/train/train_host.cpp: summary, replays, legs), the walker viewer, rigEntity / RigPoseApply / GaitChecks of the kinematic walk.

components.name: HumanBotSpawn
components.summary: The scene entity asking for the world's HumanBot walker: its body and params files and modes.

fields.name: body
fields.desc: Body file under resources/ (required).

fields.name: params
fields.desc: Params file under resources/ (required).

fields.name: kinematic
fields.desc: JSON motion: "dynamic" (default) or "kinematic" (rig_anim, demo recorders).

fields.name: recording
fields.desc: Unity's recording: header x, z zeroed, no randomisation or death.

fields.name: draw
fields.desc: WorldShape entities for WorldView.

fields.name: view
fields.desc: walker_view: no randomisation, a fixed command.

fields.name: view_truncate
fields.desc: ... with episodes truncated as in training (eval).

fields.name: view_speed
fields.desc: Command speed in view mode, 1.36.

fields.name: max_recording_ticks
fields.desc: Episode length while recording, 1000.

components.notes: Read once by AgentFactory (the first entity that has one). The same entity carries WalkRoutes, PoseTrackPlayer, and for the kinematic walk Rig, RigPose, GaitCommand, GaitParams.

components.name: WorldShape
components.summary: One shape of a world body drawn by WorldView; its Transform and PhysicsPose follow a segment.

fields.name: type
fields.desc: Kind of shape.

fields.name: half_extent
fields.desc: As RigidBody::half_extent (capsule: radius, half height, radius).

fields.name: segment
fields.desc: Segment of the ragdoll it is attached to.

fields.name: local_position
fields.desc: Pose in the segment's frame.

fields.name: local_rotation
fields.desc: Rotation in the segment's frame.

components.notes: Created with Transform and ModelRef by AgentFactory when HumanBotSpawn::draw is set (also by the animal agents and the sandbox); moved every tick by BodySync (AnimalSync for animals). Drawn by src/view/world_view.cpp.

components.name: PoseTrackPlayer
components.summary: Kinematic playback of a baked pose track on the walker's bodies.

fields.name: track
fields.desc: Track file under resources/ (.track.json, with its .track.bin), required.

fields.name: loop
fields.desc: Wrap to frame 0 at the end (teleporting), else hold the last frame.

fields.name: teleport
fields.desc: SetPositionAndRotation every frame instead of MoveKinematic.

fields.name: playing
fields.desc: Not in JSON; true.

fields.name: frame
fields.desc: Current frame.

fields.name: data
fields.desc: The loaded track (TrackActions init).

components.notes: On the HumanBotSpawn entity of rig_world (kinematic, recording). TrackActions checks the track's body and dt.

components.name: ContactRecorderHandle
components.summary: Holds the Jolt contact impulse listener of EnergyFormulas and the reports of the step.

fields.name: recorder
fields.desc: A JPH::ContactImpulseListener (patched Jolt) whose reports vector gathers every OnContactSolved of the step.

components.notes: Private to humanbot_formulas.cpp (anonymous namespace). Created by EnergyFormulas on its first eval tick, set as the world's contact impulse listener and never removed; the reports are cleared every tick.
